paper_title: On Time-Memory Tradeoffs for Maximal Palindromes with Wildcards and k-Mismatches
classifications: Theory of computation → Design and analysis of algorithms
statement: Our current approach leaves room for improvement in terms of running time. Specifically,  we leave open the problem of designing an algorithm running in time O n1.5−α for some α > 0 that finds all maximal palindromes in a string with wildcards. Moreover, an algorithm for finding the longest palindrome in the presence of wildcards and mismatches is yet to be described.
